title: Napkin Studio feature record
description: shared/data.yaml of a features/<slug>.clan. One file per feature: the design that was agreed before any code, and the build as it went. Written only through the clan CLI (scripts/feature wraps the common writes).

owner.description: Who answers for the feature (a person, not an agent).

status.description: exploring → designed (the design is approved) → building → verifying → shipped. abandoned at any point, with the reason as a decision.

problem.description: What is wrong or missing today, and for whom.

done_when.description: Acceptance: observable facts that are true when the feature is finished.

design.description: Answered BEFORE any code is written. Status may not leave `exploring` until every part is filled and the owner has approved it.

prior_art.description: Code, contracts and earlier features this builds on or could reuse. Paths, not impressions.

reuse.description: How the feature uses it, or why it can't.

approaches.description: At least two ways in, compared honestly. One is chosen; the others say why not.

cost.description: Build cost, and run cost: latency, tokens, money, ops.

rework_risks.description: Things that would make us redo work or slow the process later: repeated calls, wrong layer, a shape we will outgrow, a contract we will have to break, work done twice. Each says how the design avoids it.

contracts.description: Interfaces whose shape changes (docs/contracts/*, a .clan schema, an HTTP route, a CLI flag, a terraform output). Say who else reads each one.

breakage.description: What could break, and the test or check that would catch it.

rollout.description: Staging and production steps, migrations, config or secrets needed, how to roll back.

approved_by.description: The person who approved this design.

build_log.description: One entry per meaningful step: what changed, where, and the commit.

next_step.description: What a person or agent picking this up should do first.
